features: The Devlog area now supports advanced workflow requests, allowing owners and moderators to reopen and follow up on previously completed AI work. Community request displays have been enhanced to show proposers, voters, and advanced filtering options.
New world pointer tracking is available, showing a low-poly pyramid on the floor and a red marker above hovered enemies.
The game's central arena has been updated from a rectangular board to a larger, circular area, utilizing radial spawning and collision geometry.
The system allows for the scheduling of weekly production promotions, ensuring stable delivery of validated commits to the live environment.
Account management has been expanded to allow multiple character creation and shared stash functionality across different characters.
bugfixes: Fixed UI issues with tooltips, ensuring they remain fully visible and clamped within the viewport boundaries regardless of size or position.
UI elements, such as spell containers and HUD components, have been condensed and resized for a more compact and polished look.
Corrected the cinematic death burst mechanic to ensure the blast wave expands correctly and the damage calculations are reliable.
The mobile build now features fully scalable panels, ensuring optimal readability and functionality on both portrait and landscape touch screen layouts.
Resolved camera framing issues, recalculating panel positions and centering the character when HUD elements are opened or refreshed.
performance: Improved graphics rendering by minimizing expensive per-frame scene traversals, applying lighting and shadow modes only when essential settings or scene roots change.
balance: Spell abilities have received targeted tuning, notably adjusting the reach and cooldown curves of major attacks (Cleave, Flurry, Bash).
The 'Extract' skill system now guides players by showing current and projected learned spell maximums when hovering over the skill.
Improvements were made to the character progression system, specifically strengthening regeneration rates in early levels.
In combat, blocking rules were refined to allow consecutive rolls and ensure consistent recovery, while also implementing caps on certain block chances to prevent spamming.
ux: Developer/Devlog functionality was greatly improved, allowing users to edit requests within a dedicated modal form and organizing metadata labels into a more readable format.
The main interface layout was streamlined by moving secondary options and Devlog access into a compact, easily accessible hamburger menu.
Users can now improve the in-game experience through clearer alignment of resource bars and chat windows.
The general mobile experience was enhanced with safe-area responsive layouts and improvements to touch controls, such as previewing actions on tap and executing them on hold.
graphics: Graphics quality was optimized for stable lighting effects, specifically refining the appearance of Blizzard and Thunder lighting to prevent visual jitter and interpolation errors.
The 'Death Burst' sequence now includes a flash of red light and scattered particles, enhancing the visual impact of enemy elimination.
Overall graphic polish focused on improving the visual presentation of various spell effects and enemy encounters.
